text:
Maya: Heads-up — infra is seeing degraded text-generation in EU. Need customer-facing status + timing. Ops wants a short confirm window before we publish.
Sam: Confirmed elevated 5xxs hitting hosted API. We're initiating a rollback. Give us ~12m to get the first signal.
Priya: We have a webinar pre-reg list for 2pm PT. If we wait too long folks will get surprised. Suggest staged messaging: soft alert now, fuller update after rollback.
Diego: Support queue spiking. Can we get a canned reply ready? :loudspeaker:
Maya: Draft status (short): "We are investigating higher error rates for text-generation in EU. Engineers are rolling back a recent deploy; updates every 15 minutes." Add suggestions.
Sam: Looks good. Add “no action required from customers” and include status link when we publish: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2023-1432
Priya: Also propose a 2pm PT customer Q&A webinar for impacted customers — we can route registrants to AEs and triage inbound leads.
Diego: Canned reply (support): "We're aware of increased errors affecting text-generation in EU. We're rolling back a recent deploy. Follow live updates at <https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2023-1432>. Reply 'URGENT' if production is impaired and we'll prioritize'"
Maya: Ops prefers we wait until rollback starts to publish ETA-like copy. Marketing prefers to soft-publish to avoid surprise. Compromise: publish a "preliminary/investigating" status now, then swap to full update after rollback verification.
Priya: For inbound routing — webinar signup should auto-assign accounts >$5k MRR to AEs. Use Zapier flow: form -> AE queue. Also add utm=inc2023 on links.
Sam: Ops agrees to soft publish now but no ETA lines until rollback shows stable signals. Keep "updates every 15 minutes" line.
Maya: Final short status (v1) for publish: "Investigating increased errors for text-generation in EU. Engineers are rolling back a recent deploy. We’ll post updates every 15 minutes. No action required; follow https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2023-1432 for live updates. For customers needing immediate help reply 'URGENT' or contact support@redwood.ai."
Diego: I’ll push the canned reply to Intercom + enable in our macros. Priya: I’ll publish the webinar registration page and pre-reg email with the soft note.
incident-bot: Deploy rollback started on host-gpu-12 at 2023-11-02T14:12:34Z — monitoring.
Sam: Rollback in progress. Publishing v1 (preliminary badge) now.
Maya: Published. Pushing short social/web copy for comms team: "Prelim: We're investigating an incident affecting text-generation in EU. Follow status for updates. Webinar Q&A at 2pm PT for impacted customers — register: https://redwood.ai/webinars/incident-qa?utm=inc2023"
Priya: Webinar link created and Zapier routing set to AE queue. I added the pre-reg email to go out only to customers in affected regions.
Diego: Support volume peaked then fell after rollback kicked. Keeping canned reply active and triaging 'URGENT' tags.
Maya: Checkpoint: after 30m we meet to decide webinar go/no-go and full status wording. Meeting time ~14:42Z. @Sam @Priya @Diego please be on.
Sam: Ack.
Priya: Ack.
Diego: Ack.
Maya: Thanks team — good tradeoffs on soft publish + webinar routing. Will follow up with final copy post-checkpoint. :rocket:
